summary: Running Governance CLI or enforcement is optional; this does not forbid a declared dependency on its Config library. The inspected architecture records SDD Commands adoption of published FS.GG.Governance.Config 0.3.0 while SDD 2.3 publication and installed adoption remain pending. Rendering’s portable Scene core has no Game, Audio or Governance dependency, while its generated profiles explicitly pin Game and Audio packages. Game.Core, Audio and Net retain render-independent core boundaries; adapters and generated compositions must be assessed at their actual project/package scope. Templates composes published producers at scaffold time. This corrects an inaccurate original Atlas summary: the cited architecture already distinguished the Config library from optional enforcement. Authentic citation hashes alone did not establish the summary’s correctness.
title: Core dependencies and optional Governance enforcement
